turns.text: Reading the complaint about a charge after cancelling.
Confirming the web cancellation in session events.
Checking subscriptions and the new charge.
Looking for a sync failure around the cancellation.
Checking whether other customers hit the same bug.
This is a backend bug affecting many customers; it belongs to the tech team.

input.customerGoal: Stay cancelled and not be charged again.
input.summary: The customer cancelled on the web (ev_0006), but the cancel never reached the linked App Store subscription (err_0002, CANCEL_SYNC_TIMEOUT), so pay_0004 was charged 3 minutes later. 37 other customers match the same signature.

evidence.note: $29.99 App Store charge 3 minutes after the cancel

techIssue.title: Web cancellation not synced to App Store
techIssue.rootCause: The cancel-sync job times out (CANCEL_SYNC_TIMEOUT), so linked App Store subscriptions keep renewing after a web cancel.

input.replyDraft: Hi Liam, you're right — you cancelled correctly and the charge is our bug. Our tech team is fixing it, and we'll make sure you're refunded as soon as it's resolved.
